platform.resize.fresh: Open a fresh session to initialize the original display.
platform.resize.selector: The original display canvas is unavailable.
platform.resize.unavailable: The original display dimensions are unavailable.
platform.resize.dimensions: The original display and window dimensions do not match.
platform.resize.viewport: Wait until the original display has finished drawing.
platform.resize.logical: Wait until the original game has finished resizing.
platform.resize.busy: Wait until the current action or save has finished.
